source_text: I will take you up on the idea of redrawing the figure.  Right now there are big white gaps, the text is unreadable at scale, and clicking into the gray nodes at the bottom does nothing of interest.

fragments.text: I will take you up on the idea of redrawing the figure.
Right now there are big white gaps, the text is unreadable at scale, and clicking into the gray nodes at the bottom does nothing of interest.

reply_text:
Reading the data the figure is drawn from and the catalogue text for each node, so the redraw can show a plain description when a box is clicked. Next I write the new drawing.The new drawing script is written; its first run hit a name clash, which I am fixing now before looking at the rendered figure.The redrawn figure renders and its labels are readable; I'm now tidying the arrow routing and checking the result in a browser before putting it on the page.The redrawn figure passed its browser checks on the About page; I'm committing it now (site and script), without pushing.㊥ ("redrawing the figure") Done: the About page now has its own drawing of the harness, with no wide gaps, readable labels, and a panel that describes whichever box you point at or click, grey ones included. It is committed on futon7a `master` as `d2e83da` and not pushed.

㊢ ("big white gaps") The boxes now sit in a tight grid, one column per stage. The grey boxes are at the foot of their own stage columns, so the separate band at the bottom is gone. Arrows run along the gaps between rows and columns and never pass behind a box.

㊢ ("the text is unreadable at scale") The drawing is 1190 units wide where it was 1730, and the text is larger. Module names and term labels have moved off the drawing into the panel.

| Window | Box names in the page | Box names enlarged |
|---|---|---|
| 1600 by 900 | 12.2 px | 14.2 px |
| 1366 by 768 | 10.4 px | 12.1 px |

㊢ ("clicking into the gray nodes at the bottom does nothing of interest") Pointing at any box fills a panel under the grid, and clicking keeps that box selected.
- **Every box:** its name, stage, Lean modules, and the terms it uses and provides, coloured by how the Lean model carries each. The name comes from the paper's Pattern map table, or from the stage map where the table has no row.
- **Grey boxes:** the same, plus a line saying no Lean module is placed there. R10, for example, shows "Counts state change, not scheduler firing, as liveness."
- **Boxes with arrows:** their arrows stay lit and the others go pale.
- **R20:** its label on the frame is clickable too.
- **Legend and counts:** now inside the drawing; the old one had no key to the colours.

㊬ (what I checked) I served the site locally and drove Chromium at both window sizes above; there were no page errors.
- **Fit:** no label overflows its box, and nothing scrolls inside the frame.
- **Panel:** pointing at R10 and clicking R15 and R20 show their name and role; a click on the background clears it.
- **Selection:** clicking R4 lights its 12 arrows and pales the other 31, and holds while the pointer moves elsewhere.
- **Enlarging:** the box still opens on rest and closes from the margin.

㊟ (what you may not like)
- **Box order:** within a column the script orders boxes to make arrows shortest, so R8 sits above R2 and R5 above R4.
- **Dense arrows:** the top three rows are still crowded between BELIEVE and EVALUATE; selecting a box is what makes them traceable.
- **Missing roles:** R3a, R19, the two CTAU boxes and SCAN have no row in the Pattern map, so they show a label and no role sentence.
- **SCAN's label:** "Scan observation model" is my wording, taken from the heading of `ScanLearning.lean`.
- **Phones:** at phone width the text is still too small to read.

㊢ (where the work is) I did this myself rather than belling Codex, since it needed a look-and-adjust loop. The p4ng audit figure and its generator are untouched.
- **futon7a `d2e83da`:** `harness.html` and `about.html` (new proportions, caption, frame address).
- **futon7 `25bc9f9`:** `scripts/harness-figure.bb` replaces `harness-figure.py`; it reads p4ng's generated data, so rerun it after the Lean figure is regenerated.

🈸 (to see it) `git push origin master` in futon7a, then reload the About page.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-2
previous_reply_acts.text: ("it should be static and full-size relative to its raised element") Done. The enlarged box now shows the whole drawing and nothing moves when the pointer moves. It is committed on futon7a `master` as `ffa1204` and not pushed.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-2
previous_reply_acts.text:
("increase its size / decrease its boundary a bit") The box now takes up to 92% of the window's width and height, where it was 80%. It has the drawing's own proportions, so the whole drawing fits in it.
- **At 1600 by 900:** the box is 1472 by 617, against 1260 by 528 in the page. That is about 17% larger each way.
- **Margin:** 4% of the window's width on each side (64 px at 1600), and more above and below. Moving the pointer into any of it closes the box, as before.
- **Sliding code:** removed entirely from the embedded page, not just switched off.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-2
previous_reply_acts.text:
(what I checked) I served the site locally and drove Chromium with Playwright at 1600 by 900. Every check passed and the page raised no errors.
- **Still:** the SCAN box is at the same position before and after moving the pointer across the box.
- **Aim:** clicking R16 in the enlarged view now selects R16. With sliding it had landed on SCAN.
- **Open and close:** the margin, Escape, no reopen loop, a quick pass not opening, and a narrow window staying inline all still pass.
- **Phone with a mouse:** the emulated case still opens for a mouse and not for a finger.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-2
previous_reply_acts.text: (how much "full size" can gain) The gain is limited because the figure in the page is already about 79% of the window's width. The remaining option for making the small labels larger is to change the drawing itself, for example larger label text in the generator. Say if you want that.

previous_reply_acts.text: ("SCAN confirmed to be placed as desired") Noted; nothing further on that. The derivation script in futon7 is updated to match (`f6df29d`).
